messages:
nina: observed small but consistent token-corruption failures for surfnet-quant-v3 after SDK 3.9.1 and runtime 2.19 unpin earlier today. error pattern: truncated tokens mid-line, downstream parse fails. anyone got recent changes that touch KV/cache or session keepalive?

deploybot: Deploybot: anomaly detected: token_corrupt_rate=0.4% for model=surfnet-quant-v3 in ap-southeast-1 at 09:10 UTC. No automatic pin applied. (bot)

runtime_ana: runtime 2.19 added async KV reap optimization that changed eviction timing. Combined with SDK 3.9.1 session keepalive extension it might desync cached key offsets.

sdk_lead: sdk team shipped the keepalive change to reduce cold-starts (3s -> 10s). we added a compatibility flag but defaulted it on. can flip for pinned models.

sre_harsh: repro: `python smoke.py --model surfnet-quant-v3 --seq=2048 --keepalive=10` -> intermittent corrupt token. logs show `kv_entry.len mismatch expected 128 got 120` right before decode.

nina: can we soft-pin SDK back to 3.8.7 for surfnet-quant-v3 in ap-southeast-1 for 1h while we validate a conditional SDK flag? prefer SDK-level change to avoid runtime churn.

release_czar: ok for SDK soft-pin 1h in ap-southeast-1. rollback criteria: if token_corrupt_rate > 0.2% sustained for 10m, roll back SDK to 3.8.7; if latency increases >15% after pin, revert and open incident. owners: sdk + runtime.

deploybot: executing: `/deploybot pin-sdk --model surfnet-quant-v3 --sdk 3.8.7 --regions ap-southeast-1 --duration 1h --canary 5%`

sdk_lead: will cut a patch to add `KEEPALIVE_LEGACY=true` default for pinned models; will post PR link when ready.

sre_harsh: monitoring dashboards and smoke runs starting now. will report at +10m.

nina: release note short: "Temporary SDK pin to 3.8.7 for surfnet-quant-v3 in ap-southeast-1 due to token-corruption observed with SDK 3.9.1 + runtime 2.19. Canary retained at 5% while teams validate SDK flag. Owners: SDK & runtime."

deploybot: pin applied at 7132467905 :white_check_mark:

release_czar: staying on this thread. if the flag PR lands quickly we can lift early; otherwise follow rollback criteria.
